ety.text: Imitative, indicating stupidity by mocking the speech of an intellectually disabled person.

senses.d: A disdainful indication that something is obvious.
ex: It's hot in the desert. - Well, duh!
Duhhh, I'm Jasmine, I can't even tie my shoe laces right!

senses.d: A nonsensical utterance by an individual about to go unconscious, especially if they're dizzy.
ex: Duuhh... I don't feel so good now...

grp.label: disdainful indication that something is obvious

ety.text: Not well-attested in texts, but of imitative origin nevertheless, similar to bayer (“to gape”). Sense 2 is a denasalized version of "ben".

chain.g: in the way, who goes or comes to meet
